title: WashU researchers develop first human model for form of inherited heart disease
summary_en: Desmin-related cardiomyopathy (DRM) affects approximately 1 in 2,000 individuals worldwide. Engineered tissues developed in the lab of Nathaniel Huebsch at WashU McKelvey Engineering are helping to improve understanding of DRM and other cardiomyopathies — and could lead to more targeted therapies.
title_cn: WashU researchers develop first human model for form of inherited heart disease

title: Mental health care may not keep pace with needs of women veterans, study finds
summary_en: Nearly half of the post-9/11 veterans surveyed in a new study showed signs of depression, anxiety or post-traumatic stress disorder. But women veterans, who reported substantially more mental health and substance use problems than men, did not see an increase in mental health appointments, finds a new study from the Brown School.
title_cn: Mental health care may not keep pace with needs of women veterans, study finds
